source.text: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not to us, YHWH, not to us, but to your name give glory, because of your loyal love, because of your faithfulness.

en.L: Not to us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, not to us, but to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name give glory, because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness.
en.B: Do not give us the glory, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not give it to us. Give it to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not bring honor to us. Do not bring it to us! Bring honor to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own name, because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love and because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promises.

fr.L: Non pas à nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, non pas à nous, mais à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom donne la gloire, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité.
fr.B: Ne nous donne pas la gloire, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne nous la donne pas. Donne-la à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne fais pas honneur à nous. Non, pas à nous ! Fais honneur à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propre nom, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tiens {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} promesses.

decisions.choice: to your name give glory: act so that your name is honored
alternatives: the glory belongs to your name, not ours
decisions.reason: The prayer asks the LORD to act for his own honor, now mocked by the nations (verse 2), not for Israel's credit. It also confesses that any glory belongs to him alone.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: faithfulness: being true to his word
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is firmness and truth: the LORD can be relied on to do what he promised. It is often paired with chesed (25:10; 117:2).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: honor
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer word for the honor given to someone.

records.literal_gloss: Why should the nations say, Where now [is] their God?

en.L: Why should the nations say, "Where now [is] their God?"
en.B: Why should the nations be allowed to say, "So where is their God?"
en.R: Why should other nations be able to make fun of us and say, "Where is their God?"

fr.L: Pourquoi les nations diraient-elles : « Où donc [est] leur Dieu ? »
fr.B: Pourquoi laisserait-on les nations dire : « Alors, où est leur Dieu ? »
fr.R: Pourquoi les autres nations pourraient-elles se moquer de nous et dire : « Où est leur Dieu ? »

decisions.choice: Where is their God: the taunt of enemies
decisions.reason: The same mocking question is thrown at the psalmist in 42:4 and 42:11 and at Israel in 79:10. It suggests that Israel's God cannot help.

decisions.choice: make fun of us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the question is: mockery.

records.literal_gloss: But our God [is] in the heavens; all that he pleases he does.

en.L: But our God [is] in the heavens; all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pleases {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does.
en.B: Yet our God is in the heavens, and whatever {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wills, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does.
en.R: But our God is in heaven, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants to do.

fr.L: Mais notre Dieu [est] dans les cieux ; tout ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait.
fr.B: Pourtant notre Dieu est dans les cieux, et tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait.
fr.R: Mais notre Dieu est au ciel, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut faire.

decisions.choice: But our God: the answer to the taunt
decisions.reason: To "Where is their God?" the answer is: in the heavens, free to do whatever he chooses, unlike the idols that cannot move (verses 4-7).

decisions.choice: he pleases he does: he is free and able
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form for completed or settled action: whatever he has wanted, he has done (135:6).

source.text: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Their idols [are] silver and gold, [the] work of [the] hands of humankind.

en.L: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of human hands.
en.B: Their idols are made of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
en.R: The idols of the nations are only silver and gold. People made them with their own hands.

fr.L: Leurs idoles [sont] argent et or, œuvre de mains humaines.
fr.B: Leurs idoles sont faites d’argent et d’or, façonnées par des mains humaines.
fr.R: Les idoles des nations ne sont que de l’argent et de l’or. Ce sont des gens qui les ont faites de leurs propres mains.

decisions.choice: idols: the same lines as Psalm 135:15-18
decisions.reason: Verses 4-8 appear again, almost word for word, in 135:15-18. Both mock idols as things made by people that have every part of a living body but no life (Isaiah 44:9-20; Deuteronomy 4:28).

decisions.choice: their: the nations'
decisions.reason: "Their" points back to the nations of verse 2: Israel's God is in heaven; theirs are made in a workshop.

decisions.choice: the idols of the nations
decisions.reason: Readable names whose idols they are (m2).

source.text: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A mouth [is] to them and not they speak; eyes [are] to them and not they see.

en.L: They have a mouth, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see.
en.B: They have a mouth, yet say nothing; they have eyes, yet see nothing.
en.R: Idols have mouths, but they cannot talk. They have eyes, but they cannot see.

fr.L: Elles ont une bouche, mais elles ne parlent pas ; elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne voient pas.
fr.B: Elles ont une bouche, et ne disent rien ; elles ont des yeux, et ne voient rien.
fr.R: Les idoles ont une bouche, mais elles ne peuvent pas parler. Elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne peuvent pas voir.

decisions.choice: a mouth but no speech: the idol is lifeless
decisions.reason: The list (verses 5-7) runs through the parts of the body that the craftsman carved and shows that none of them works. The contrast is with the God who speaks, sees and acts (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Idols
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject to keep it clear.

source.text: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Ears [are] to them and not they hear; a nose [is] to them and not they smell.

en.L: They have ears, but they do not hear; they have a nose, but they do not smell.
en.B: They have ears, yet hear nothing; they have a nose, yet smell nothing.
en.R: They have ears, but they cannot hear. They have noses, but they cannot smell.

fr.L: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles n’entendent pas ; elles ont un nez, mais elles ne sentent pas.
fr.B: Elles ont des oreilles, et n’entendent rien ; elles ont un nez, et ne sentent rien.
fr.R: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles ne peuvent pas entendre. Elles ont un nez, mais elles ne peuvent pas sentir.

decisions.choice: a nose that cannot smell: offerings wasted
decisions.reason: Incense and the smoke of sacrifices were offered to idols as a pleasing smell, but the idol cannot smell them (Deuteronomy 4:28).

source.text: יְדֵיהֶ֤ם׀וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Their hands, and not they feel; their feet, and not they walk; not they make a sound with their throat.

en.L: Their hands — but they do not feel; their feet — but they do not walk; they do not make a sound with their throat.
en.B: They have hands, yet feel nothing; feet, yet never walk; no sound comes from their throats.
en.R: They have hands, but they cannot feel. They have feet, but they cannot walk. They cannot make a sound with their throats.

fr.L: Leurs mains, mais elles ne touchent pas ; leurs pieds, mais elles ne marchent pas ; elles ne font aucun son de leur gosier.
fr.B: Elles ont des mains, et ne touchent rien ; des pieds, et ne marchent jamais ; aucun son ne sort de leur gorge.
fr.R: Elles ont des mains, mais elles ne peuvent rien toucher. Elles ont des pieds, mais elles ne peuvent pas marcher. Elles ne peuvent faire aucun bruit avec leur gorge.

decisions.choice: their hands ... their feet: short, broken lines
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes the pattern here: "their hands" and "their feet" stand alone before the verbs, as if pointing at them.

decisions.choice: make a sound: even a murmur
decisions.reason: The verb (hagah) is used of low sounds, a murmur or the growl of a lion (1:2). The idols cannot make even that much noise.

source.text: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.

en.L: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.
en.B: The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who relies on them.
en.R: People who make idols will become as useless as the idols are, and so will everyone who trusts in them.

fr.L: Comme elles seront ceux qui les font, quiconque se confie en elles.
fr.B: Ceux qui les fabriquent finiront comme elles, et de même tous ceux qui s’appuient sur elles.
fr.R: Ceux qui fabriquent des idoles deviendront aussi inutiles qu’elles, et de même tous ceux qui ont confiance en elles.

decisions.choice: will be: a statement, or a wish
decisions.reason: The verb (yihyu) can be read as "they will be" or "may they be". Either way, those who worship idols become like them, without life or sense (Jeremiah 2:5).

decisions.choice: people become like what they worship
decisions.reason: The lines teach that worship shapes the worshiper: trust in something lifeless leaves people lifeless, while those who trust the LORD find help (verses 9-11).

decisions.choice: as useless as the idols are
decisions.reason: Readable says in what way they become like the idols (m2).

source.text: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Israel, trust in YHWH; their help and their shield [is] he.

en.L: Israel, trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Their help and their shield [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}.
en.B: People of Israel, put your trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
en.R: People of Israel, trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He helps those who trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} protects them like a shield.

fr.L: Israël, confie-toi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Leur secours et leur bouclier, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Peuple d’Israël, mets ta confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui les secourt et qui les protège comme un bouclier.
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, aie confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Il aide ceux qui ont confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les protège comme un bouclier.

decisions.choice: their help and their shield is he: a sung response
decisions.reason: The call is to "you" (trust!), but the reply speaks of "their" help. It may be a response sung by another voice, perhaps priests or choir, as the psalm was used in worship. The same line ends verses 9, 10 and 11.

decisions.choice: shield: protection
decisions.reason: As in 3:4 and 28:7, the LORD is the shield that guards his people from harm.

decisions.choice: Israel, the house of Aaron, those who fear the LORD
decisions.reason: Verses 9-11 and 12-13 call three groups in turn: all Israel, the priests descended from Aaron, and all who fear the LORD (as in 118:2-4 and 135:19-20).

decisions.choice: those who trust him
decisions.reason: Readable says who "they" are (m1).

source.text: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: House of Aaron, trust in YHWH; their help and their shield [is] he.

en.L: House of Aaron, trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Their help and their shield [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}.
en.B: House of Aaron, put your trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
en.R: Priests of Aaron's family, trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He helps those who trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} protects them like a shield.

fr.L: Maison d’Aaron, confiez-vous {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Leur secours et leur bouclier, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Maison d’Aaron, mettez votre confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui les secourt et qui les protège comme un bouclier.
fr.R: Prêtres de la famille d’Aaron, ayez confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Il aide ceux qui ont confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les protège comme un bouclier.

decisions.choice: house of Aaron: the priests
decisions.reason: The priests were the descendants of Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 28:1).

decisions.choice: their help and their shield is he: a sung response
decisions.reason: As in 115:9.

decisions.choice: Priests of Aaron's family
decisions.reason: Readable says who the house of Aaron are (m1).

source.text: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: [Those who] fear YHWH, trust in YHWH; their help and their shield [is] he.

en.L: You who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Their help and their shield [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}.
en.B: You who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, put your trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
en.R: All who fear and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! He helps those who trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} protects them like a shield.

fr.L: Vous qui craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, confiez-vous {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Leur secours et leur bouclier, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Vous qui craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mettez votre confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui les secourt et qui les protège comme un bouclier.
fr.R: Vous tous qui honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect, ayez confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! Il aide ceux qui ont confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les protège comme un bouclier.

decisions.choice: those who fear the LORD: all true worshipers
decisions.reason: After Israel and the priests, the phrase may sum up all who worship the LORD, or it may mean people from other nations who had come to worship him (compare Acts 10:2).

decisions.choice: their help and their shield is he: a sung response
decisions.reason: As in 115:9.

decisions.choice: fear and honor
decisions.reason: As in 111:5.

source.text: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has remembered us; he will bless; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has remembered us; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless the house of Israel; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless the house of Aaron.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has kept us in mind, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless the people of Israel, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless the family of Aaron.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has not forgotten us, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bless us: the people of Israel and the priests of Aaron's family.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est souvenu de nous ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira la maison d’Israël ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira la maison d’Aaron.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a pensé à nous, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira le peuple d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} bénira la famille d’Aaron.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne nous a pas oubliés, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous bénira : le peuple d’Israël et les prêtres de la famille d’Aaron.

decisions.choice: remembered: kept in mind and acted for
decisions.reason: When God "remembers" someone, he acts for them (8:5; Genesis 8:1).

decisions.choice: he will bless: a promise, or a wish
decisions.reason: The verb (yevarekh) may be a promise ("he will bless") or a prayer ("may he bless"). The repetition matches the threefold call of verses 9-11.

decisions.choice: us
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the object, which the first "he will bless" leaves open.

records.literal_gloss: He will bless those fearing YHWH, the small with the great.

en.L: He will bless those who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the small together with the great.
en.B: He will bless all who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the least of them and the greatest alike.
en.R: He will bless everyone who fears and honors {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, whether they are important or not.

fr.L: Il bénira ceux qui craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les petits avec les grands.
fr.B: Il bénira tous ceux qui craignent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les plus petits comme les plus grands.
fr.R: Il bénira tous ceux qui honorent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect, qu’ils soient importants ou non.

decisions.choice: the small with the great: everyone
decisions.reason: The pair means all people of every rank and age (104:25; Revelation 19:5 echoes the phrase).

decisions.choice: fears and honors
decisions.reason: As in 111:5.

records.literal_gloss: May YHWH add to you, to you and to your children.

en.L: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} add to you, to you and to your children.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you grow in number, you and your children too.
en.R: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make your families grow larger and larger, yours and your children's.

fr.L: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous accroisse, vous et vos enfants.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous rende nombreux, vous et vos enfants aussi.
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rende vos familles de plus en plus grandes, les vôtres et celles de vos enfants.

decisions.choice: add: increase in number
decisions.reason: The verb (yasaf) is to add. Said of people, it means to multiply them, as in Moses' blessing in Deuteronomy 1:11.

source.text: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [are] you by YHWH, maker of heaven and earth.

en.L: Blessed [are] you by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, maker of heaven and earth.
en.B: You are blessed by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made the heavens and the earth.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made the sky and the earth, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} blesses you!

fr.L: Bénis [êtes]-vous {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui a fait le ciel et la terre.
fr.B: Vous êtes bénis par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui a fait les cieux et la terre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait le ciel et la terre, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous bénit !

decisions.choice: maker of heaven and earth
decisions.reason: The title recurs in the psalms of this group (121:2; 124:8; 134:3; 146:6) and recalls Melchizedek's blessing (Genesis 14:19). The LORD made all things, unlike the idols, which were themselves made (verse 4).

decisions.choice: Blessed are you: a blessing spoken over the people
decisions.reason: The priests may speak these words over the worshipers (Numbers 6:23-27). The form (barukh) can state a fact or give a blessing.

source.text: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The heavens, heavens [belong] to YHWH, but the earth he has given to [the] children of humankind.

en.L: The heavens [are] the heavens of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but the earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given to the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}}.
en.B: The heavens are {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s own heavens; the earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has handed over to humankind.
en.R: The sky above belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given the earth to people.

fr.L: Les cieux [sont] les cieux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mais la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a donnée aux {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: Les cieux sont les propres cieux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a confiée aux {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.R: Le ciel appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné la terre aux gens.

decisions.choice: The heavens, the heavens of the LORD: emphasis
decisions.reason: The repeated word stresses that the heavens are his own domain. The earth is his gift to people to live in and care for (Genesis 1:28; 8:7 in the Psalms).

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4.

source.text: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל־יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not the dead praise Yah, nor all [who] go down [to] silence.

en.L: [It is] not the dead [who] praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, nor any who go down [into] silence.
en.B: The dead do not praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, nor do any who sink down into the silence.
en.R: Dead people cannot praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}. No one who has gone down to the silent grave can sing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: [Ce ne sont] pas les morts [qui] louent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, ni aucun de ceux qui descendent [dans le] silence.
fr.B: Les morts ne louent pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, ni aucun de ceux qui sombrent dans le silence.
fr.R: Les morts ne peuvent pas louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}. Aucun de ceux qui sont descendus dans le silence de la tombe ne peut chanter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: silence: the world of the dead
decisions.reason: The word (dumah) is silence, here the silent place of the dead (94:17), where no songs are sung (6:6; 88:11-13).

decisions.choice: the silent grave
decisions.reason: Readable says what the silence is (m2).

records.literal_gloss: But we, we will bless Yah from now and until forever. Praise Yah!

en.L: But we, we will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} from now and until forever. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: As for us, we will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} now and for all time to come. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: But we who are alive will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} now and always. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Mais nous, nous bénirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} dès maintenant et jusqu’à toujours. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Quant à nous, nous bénirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, maintenant et pour tous les temps à venir. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Mais nous qui sommes vivants, nous louerons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, maintenant et toujours. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

decisions.choice: But we: the living, set against the dead
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic: unlike the dead of verse 17, "we" who are alive will bless the LORD.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: Praise the LORD: Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is two words: a plural command, "praise!" (hallelu), and Yah, the short form of the divine name (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It calls the gathered people to praise. Like the full name, Yah is rendered "the LORD", with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: who are alive
decisions.reason: Readable makes the contrast with verse 17 plain (m1).
